name: @sma/types
description: Shared TypeScript types for the Somali Music AI Preservation Platform: the wire/domain contracts (Recording, Artist, User, Lesson, API envelope) consumed identically by mobile, web, and the Node API so a schema change can never drift between client and server.
//: WHY a raw-TypeScript internal package (main points at src): matches @sma/constants — every app compiles these files with its own toolchain (Metro, Next, tsc), so there is no build step to keep in sync and no stale .d.ts can drift from source. These are type-only declarations; they emit nothing at runtime.

scripts.test: echo "@sma/types: no runtime tests — contracts are asserted via typecheck" && exit 0
